ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; the ventral surface is approximately 95% dark pigmentation with localized high-intensity clusters at the tips and minimal scattered white spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark contiguous region across both lobes; high-contrast white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips (left and right margins); sparse white point-source pixels are distributed across the central-left and central-right fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central indentation; vertex is sharp with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude; trailing edge exhibits significant jaggedness with several deep, non-uniform notches across both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edge tapering into sharp, barnacle-encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity circular pixel clusters located on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) oriented horizontally/diagonally on the upper section of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge; multiple linear surface scratches on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated barnacle accumulation specifically on the vertical edges of the distal tips, creating a distinctive high-contrast white border.
